source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "smart citizens" OR "citizen sensing" OR "civic apps" OR FixMyStreet
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"smart citizens" OR "citizen sensing" OR "civic apps" OR FixMyStreet,is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("FixMyStreet" OR "citizen sensing" OR "civic apps" OR "smart citizens")
